calls.label: B-vm-hub-test-comparison-in-1-0
argv:
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ERROR missing binary: python3'; exit 127; }
python3 -c '
import json, os, signal, shutil, subprocess, sys
cmd = ['"'"'bash'"'"', '"'"'-c'"'"', "date -u; ip route get 10.60.1.4; echo '"'"'=== ICMP connectivity ==='"'"'; timeout 12 ping -n -c 5 -W 1 10.60.1.4; echo PING_STATUS=$?; echo '"'"'=== ICMP mtr ==='"'"'; timeout 20 mtr -n -r -c 5 --max-ttl 8 10.60.1.4; echo MTR_STATUS=$?; echo '"'"'=== ICMP traceroute ==='"'"'; if command -v traceroute >/dev/null; then timeout 12 traceroute -n -I -m 8 -q 1 -w 1 10.60.1.4; echo TRACE_STATUS=$?; else echo '"'"'NOT_CAPTURED: traceroute unavailable; ICMP mtr captured above'"'"'; fi"]
if not shutil.which(cmd[0]):
    print('"'"'ERROR missing binary: '"'"' + cmd[0]); print('"'"'COMMAND_STATUS=127'"'"'); sys.exit(127)
p = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
try:
    data, _ = p.communicate(timeout=55)
    status = p.returncode
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
    data, _ = p.communicate(timeout=3)
    status = 124
offset = 0 * 2800
print(json.dumps({'"'"'command'"'"': cmd, '"'"'status'"'"': status, '"'"'bytes'"'"': len(data),
                  '"'"'chunk'"'"': 0, '"'"'chunks'"'"': max(1, (len(data)+2799)//2800)}))
print(data[offset:offset+2800].decode('"'"'utf-8'"'"', errors='"'"'replace'"'"'))
if len(data) > 2800:
    print('"'"'ERROR OUTPUT_PAGED: not a complete atomic snapshot; never treat as full packet proof'"'"')
print('"'"'COMMAND_STATUS='"'"' + str(status))
print('"'"'UDR_STATUS=0'"'"')
'
